# @codeatlasdev/ui

> Svelte 5 UI framework. DX-first, AI-ready. Not a component collection: a UI engine. Build complete interfaces (page layouts, navigation shells, data tables, charts, forms) with zero CSS decisions. 60+ components, 8 OKLCH themes, Liquid Glass surfaces. Published on npm as @codeatlasdev/ui.

## Overview

- [README](README.md): installation, usage, component list, CSS architecture
- [AI Agent guide](AGENTES.md): full guide for AI agents: component APIs, critical rules, token names, store interfaces, AppShell patterns

## Source

- [Library barrel export](packages/ui/src/lib/index.ts): all exported symbols
- [Components](packages/ui/src/lib/components/): every Svelte component
- [Tokens](packages/ui/src/lib/tokens/): TypeScript token objects (colors, typography, shape, transitions, zIndex, shadows, materials)
- [Stores](packages/ui/src/lib/stores/): reactive $state stores (colorScheme, reducedMotion, responsive)
- [Utils](packages/ui/src/lib/utils/): debounce, clipboard, localStorage, palette-generator

## Styles

- [global.css](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/global.css): CSS @import entry point (consumers import this)
- [base.css](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/base.css): reset, html/body mesh gradient, typography scale, focus, scrollbar
- [tokens.css](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/tokens.css): static :root CSS custom properties + .dark overrides
- [materials.css](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/materials.css): glass material utility classes (regular/thick/thin/ultrathin/ultrachick)
- [presets/](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/presets/): amber, ocean, crimson, cyan, violet, emerald, rose, slate

## Key components

- [AppShellLayout](packages/ui/src/lib/components/AppShell/AppShellLayout.svelte): root layout with Rail + Panel + main area
- [AppShell types](packages/ui/src/lib/components/AppShell/types.ts): NavModule, NavItem, NavSection, helper functions
- [DataTable](packages/ui/src/lib/components/DataTable/DataTable.svelte): TanStack Table v9 server-side data grid. Import from `@codeatlasdev/ui/table` (peer: `@tanstack/svelte-table`)
- Charts import from `@codeatlasdev/ui/charts` (peer: `echarts`); CodeSnippet from `@codeatlasdev/ui/code` (peer: `shiki`). None of them are in the root import
- [DataTable hook](packages/ui/src/lib/components/DataTable/table-hook.svelte.ts): createCaTable, createCaColumnHelper, caTableFeatures
- [SiteHeader](packages/ui/src/lib/components/SiteHeader/SiteHeader.svelte): top bar component
- [Docs primitives](packages/ui/src/lib/components/Docs/): DocsShell, DocsNav, TableOfContents, DocsSearch, CodeTabs/CodeTab, Callout, Steps, LinkCard, CardGrid, MethodBadge; `.ca-prose` typography in [prose.css](packages/ui/src/lib/styles/prose.css)
- [AlertDialog](packages/ui/src/lib/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialog.svelte): confirm dialog (`title`, `confirmLabel`, `destructive`, `pending`, async `onconfirm`); replaces native `confirm()`
- [Dialog](packages/ui/src/lib/components/Dialog/Dialog.svelte): `size="sm|md|lg|xl|split"` and `chromeless`
- `Button`/`IconButton` take `loading` (spinner, `aria-busy`, blocks click). `CopyButton`, `PinInput` (OTP), `ToggleGroup`, `SegmentedControl` are in the root import
- [Date components](packages/ui/src/lib/components/Date/): DatePicker, DateRangePicker, DateField, TimeField, Calendar, RangeCalendar (`@internationalized/date` values, pt-BR default; `CalendarDate`, `Time`, `today` re-exported)
- `SimpleTable responsive="cards"`: rows become cards below `md`; every `<td>` needs `data-label`. `--ca-touch-target` (44px) applies under `pointer: coarse`
- [Forms subpath](packages/ui/src/lib/forms/): `@codeatlasdev/ui/forms` (no peer): MaskedField, MoneyInput (value in cents), PhoneField (E.164), CepField (`onlookup` injected, no fetch), `use:mask`, maskCPF/maskCNPJ/maskCPFCNPJ/maskCEP/maskPhoneBR/maskDateBR/maskRG, isValidCPF/isValidCNPJ/isValidDateBR, centsToDisplay, parseInputToCents. `useForm` supports `arrays` (`FieldArrayState`: add/remove/move)
- [CSS API](docs/css-api.md): public `ca-*` classes per component; renaming a listed class is a breaking change

## Showcase

- [Showcase app](showcase/): SvelteKit SPA for component documentation (not published)

## Release

- [Release script](scripts/release.js): the only way to release. One command does npm publish, git tag and GitHub Release, and resumes if interrupted. Flow in CONTRIBUTING.md#release-flow
